# `≠` — Unique mask / Not equal

Keys: `Alt-Shift-=`. Ranks: `∞` monadic, `0 0` dyadic

`≠Y` marks first occurrences of major cells. Uses tolerant comparison and first matching representatives.

```bpl
≠3 1 3 2 1         ⍝ $t $t $f $t $f
```

`X≠Y` tests inequality, pervasively.

```bpl
1 2 3≠2            ⍝ $t $f $t
```

## Inverse

Unique-mask has no inverse. On Booleans, `≠` is its own inverse with either argument fixed.

```bpl
1 0 ≠⁻¹ 1 1   ⍝ $f $t
```
